provider: IGN API Carto cadastre, corroborated by DGFiP Cadastre WMS; local procedure evidence from City of Toulon
scope: Official anonymous cadastral commune/parcel geometry service, with bounded requests around Toulon WUP point.
schemaAndCrs: API Carto returned GeoJSON in WGS84/EPSG:4326, coordinates longitude,latitude. Parcel responses exposed idu, gid, numero, feuille, section and code_insee; only id and geometry are safe retention fields.
nativeIdentity: idu, a composite native cadastral identity; no synthetic row number used.

fieldMapping.sourceAttributes: gid, numero, feuille, section, code_dep, code_insee and related fields observed but not retained

requestOutcome: English and French first-party discovery succeeded. IGN commune and parcel GETs succeeded. Exact-point and smaller bounded geometry requests returned zero features; a wider bounded polygon returned five parcel features. DGFiP WMS GetCapabilities succeeded.
retainedProperties: No GeoJSON retained; unchanged request evidence is under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/toulon/.
unsafeDataPolicy: Owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, legal-description, and ownership/rights fields were not requested or retained.
officialCustodyEvidence: IGN is the official national geospatial operator for API Carto; DGFiP operates the Toulon cadastral WMS. The City of Toulon page directs users to the official cadastral plan but does not expose a municipal parcel API in this attempt.
limits: Exact WUP point miss is not evidence of citywide absence.
Wider bounded response demonstrates local service availability, not complete citywide coverage or freshness.
No owner, address, title, contact, tax, account, or rights data was requested.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception was used.
RuntimeReadiness remains held pending independent serial review.
uncertainty: Independent review must confirm current schema and idu stability, representative coverage, freshness, and adapter compatibility before source admission.
